newsitem.title: USA: Kmart names ex-Hills exec as apparel chief.
newsitem.headline: Kmart names ex-Hills exec as apparel chief.

text.p: Kmart Corp said Monday it named former Hills Stores Co. president E. Jackson Smailes as its new senior vice president and general merchandise manager of apparel.
Effective immediately, Smailes, 54, will be responsible for Kmart's apparel merchandising programs and will report to Warren Flick, U.S. Kmart Stores president and chief operating officer.
Smailes joined Canton, Mass.-based Hills as president in September 1994 and left in February 1996. He has since managed his own consulting business serving fashion retailers.

A veteran retailer, Smailes began his career with Federated Department Stores Inc in 1964, serving in various merchandising positions with the company's Lazarus Department Stores, Gold Circle Stores and Richway Stores divisions.

"Jack Smailes' apparel merchandising background will bring great strength to our apparel programs," Flick said in a statement. "His outstanding experience in merchandising, marketing, planning and operations will be valuable as Kmart focuses on our customer and responds to her family apparel needs."

Kmart's previous apparel chief, Stephen Ross, resigned in June, a move analysts attributed to the poor performance of Kmart's apparel sales this year, which has has led to heavy markdowns and setbacks in earnings.
Last month, Kmart Chairman Floyd Hall said Kmart was disappointed with its poor performance in women's apparel and vowed to "get it right in this critical area."
